verdict.rationale: Statsig is a feature-flag vendor, so OpenFeature provider support is a fair question to ask, but no evidence item mentions OpenFeature or a vendor-neutral provider. The "StatsigProvider" React component (statsig-docs-36) is Statsig's own SDK wrapper, not an OpenFeature provider. The HTTP API is a developer building block, not vendor-neutral flag code, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API
